mechanism: Learned skill extraction and skill-bank maintenance from coding-agent trajectories
evidence_scope: CODESKILLextracts multi-granularity procedural skills from coding-agent trajectories, evolves skills with new experience, and maintains a compact skill bank for future task solv- ing.
evidence_role: We proposeCODESKILL, an LLM-based framework that reformulates skill extraction and skill-bank maintenance as a learnable management policy.
